name: Aura

every.note: widens the holder's casts (std targets); ∀ = cast.aura on the widened cast

text: Each effect you cast becomes a mass effect, affecting all neighboring targets of your choice. Emit-an-element may target tokens/permanents and perform casting at the same time.
every_text: Each Permanent you cast may affect any known targets on the tileset chosen by you.
